headline: Failed House resolution would have censured Delegate Stacey Plaskett and removed her from the House Intelligence Committee over alleged contact with Jeffrey Epstein.
what_it_does: This resolution would have formally censured and condemned Delegate Stacey Plaskett, who represents the U.S. Virgin Islands in the House. It would also have removed her from the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence. According to its title, the reason given was that she worked with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein during a congressional hearing, which the resolution described as conduct that reflects badly on the House. The House voted it down on November 18, 2025.

who_it_affects.how: She would have been formally censured by the House and lost her seat on the House Intelligence Committee.

who_it_affects.group: Residents of the U.S. Virgin Islands
who_it_affects.how: Their representative in the House would have been removed from the Intelligence Committee.
